MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(:Team)
WHERE p.nationality = 'British'
   OR p.birth_date = '1972/3/6'
   OR CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE) <= DATE('1984-10-14')
RETURN p.nationality AS col1, COUNT(DISTINCT p.name) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(:Team)
WHERE p.nationality = 'British'
   OR p.birth_date = '1972/3/6'
   OR CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) < 1984
   OR (CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) = 1984 AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) < 10)
   OR (CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) = 1984 AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) <= 14)
RETURN p.nationality AS col1, COUNT(DISTINCT p.name) AS col2
